description: This file defines data models related to menu items for a restaurant app, including categories, portion options, allergens, nutritional info, and menu items, with some utility methods and metadata classes.

classes.name: MenuCategory
classes.description: Represents a category of menu items (e.g., Traditional, Street Food).

classes.name: PortionOption
classes.description: Portion size option with associated pricing.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Menu item model with dynamic pricing and customization metadata.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of MenuCategory with optional new field values.

methods.name: priceForPortion
methods.description: Returns the price for a given portion label.
